name: diagnosing-agent-sessions
description: Use when a workflow session went wrong and your human partner wants to know why — repeated work, ignored plans, stumbles, poor results, a skill that didn't fire, "it took too long", "why is it so expensive", "what is it doing" — or wants to build a bug report for the workflow maintainers, for the current session or a past one identified by id or path, on any harness.
